fixed.problem: L4-creds-2: Agent SDK 0.3.304 throws after Claude Code's error result. A refused sign-in read as Failed, Settings kept saying 'Works now', chat said 'I could not answer', every later call went to the refused sign-in again, and Costs listed '<synthetic>'.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/credential-sdk-throw.test.ts > "a refused sign-in under 'then wait' is one refused card and a waiting task; chat holds; no second request; no '<synthetic>' in Costs" (plus the throwing-fake cases in sdk-driver.test.ts and claude-code-provider.test.ts, describe "l4-cred-engine, run L4")
fixed.how: SdkAgentDriver reads the iterator through its own then(), so a throw ends the loop the same way the stream's end does, and the same mapping runs after it (usage limit, authentication_failed, the error result's verdict, error_max_budget_usd). A thrown text with no verdict before it is read by its own words, with the token cut out. ClaudeCodeProvider yields the stream's verdict from its catch. Claude Code's synthetic error message (model '<synthetic>', zero usage) is not a model call and is never booked. REFUSED_TEXT also matches 'Authentication error ·' and 'OAuth access token is invalid'.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Set up a project whose subscription sign-in has expired and press Start. The Inbox shows one card, 'Anthropic refused your Claude sign-in'. The task shows 'Waits for a new Claude sign-in', not Failed. Settings shows the subscription as Refused. Asking chat a question gets 'Anthropic refused your Claude sign-in, so I have not answered. Sign in again in Settings; ...'. Costs lists no '<synthetic>' model.

fixed.problem: L4-creds-1: A run that hit the subscription's plan share mid-run became a budget pause with a budget card waiting until the 1st, whatever policy the person chose. Raising the allowance in Settings did not end it.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/credential-share-midrun.test.ts > "under 'then the API key' the work goes on on the key from its kept work; no budget card" (and the ask/wait/raise cases); apps/ui/test/settings-plan-allowance.test.tsx new case; real-daemon describe 'l4-cred-engine, run L4'
fixed.how: The executor now reads a run's budget_exceeded at level 'plan' on the subscription as the credential stop 'share' (Run outcome usage_limit, artifact credentialStop share; report and handoff kept). The policy then decides: next, ask or wait, with the wait lasting until the next month's start. takeReady holds share and key_month waits. planUsageOf counts reported shares only from limits.planAllowanceSetAt. POST /settings/plan-allowance returns changeLine through billing.waits.allowanceRaised().
fixed.check_in_the_app: Set a small plan allowance and the policy 'Subscription first, then API key', then start a session. When the share is reached the task goes on with the API key and no budget card appears. Under 'then wait', the session ends waiting until the 1st. Raise the allowance in Settings: the saved line says 'Your subscription's allowance is raised: your session of 14:05 goes on now.'

fixed.problem: L4-creds-3: A credential card's notification did not match its Inbox card: the title differed, the time was in UTC instead of the person's zone, 'Inbox' appeared twice, and the session-end notification repeated the credential wait. The time zone and monthly cap came from the values loaded at start.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/notifications-credential-cards.test.ts, packages/runtime/test/credential-notify-once.test.ts, real-daemon case 'Use your API key until 08:26?' (TZ=UTC)
fixed.how: The notification for a new request is built from the Inbox's own context (requestContexts). It carries the card's sentence, says Inbox once, and the link goes to the card's link. The credential wait is left out of the session news while its card is open (ToldByCards.credential). The time zone and monthly cap are read at each use (zoneNow, and credentialHold reads the person row). RouteContext.nowMs is now required.
fixed.check_in_the_app: With the zone set to Europe/Zurich and the policy 'then ask', approve a plan while the subscription rests. The notification title is 'Use your API key until 08:26?', the same as the Inbox card, in local time. Exactly one notification arrives.

fixed.problem: L4-creds-4: Under a reply that said it could not answer, chat showed 'Answered with your Claude subscription: ...' and offered a paid Think it through. The stop was then marked as already said, so the first real answer had no note. Other failures read 'I could not answer (<raw error>).'
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/credential-chat-failure.test.ts (key_then_subscription: the refused sign-in's turn had the note; subscription_then_key: the 500 read 'I could not answer (model call failed).'); apps/ui/test/chat-depth.test.tsx 'L4-creds-4: no Think it through under a failed reply'
fixed.how: The switch note goes in the footer only under a completed answer, and the stop is marked as said only when the footer is that note. The closer needs a completed answer. failureReply(error) in conversation/depth.ts gives one sentence per error code and never the error's own message. A failed row is a notice, marked failed where Ask again can help. The UI never shows Think it through under a failed turn. The Messages API stand-in gained {kind:'error'} (500).
fixed.check_in_the_app: In chat, when Claude fails to answer, the reply is one sentence such as 'Claude did not answer this time; ask again in a moment.', with Ask again under it and no 'Answered with ...' or Think it through. The next real answer on the other credential shows 'Answered with your Claude subscription: your API key is at its limit until 12:00.' once.

fixed.problem: L4-creds-5: A call cut off by Stop was booked on the run's own credential, not on the credential that served it.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/credential-stop-booking.test.ts (key_then_subscription with the key resting: the cut-off call was booked to the key, USD 0.004, and nothing to the subscription)
fixed.how: When a call began and is then cut off or fails, the routed provider's error carries billing worked out from the usage message_start reported. collectStream keeps it on the response. The loop's takeBilling sets the call's source before the abort branch books it.
fixed.check_in_the_app: With the API key resting and chat answering on the subscription, press Stop during an answer. Costs by credential shows the spend under 'Your Claude subscription', not 'Your API key'.

fixed.problem: L4-creds-8 (the refused chat start, never cut): With a refused key, chat said 'I can still add, move and start tasks' while the Start dialog's Start was off. Chat's 'start a session' was read back and started while the dialog refused it.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/credential-chat-refused.test.ts (key_only, refused key: the reply ended 'add, move and start tasks.'; 'start a session' read back 'Start a session on Field notes (up to CHF 5)?'); words table in the same file
fixed.how: chatHoldReply now depends on the reason. A refused key reads '... Save a new key in Settings; until then I can still add and change tasks.'; a refused sign-in says 'Sign in again in Settings'; a limit, the share or a monthly cap reads '... I can still add and change tasks.' Chat's startBlocked port passes a refused credential's wait to startBlockedReason, as the dialog's check does, so session.start refuses with the dialog's sentence before any read-back.
fixed.check_in_the_app: With only a refused API key, ask chat 'What is next on this project?'. It says 'Anthropic refused your API key, so I have not answered. Save a new key in Settings; until then I can still add and change tasks.' Type 'start a session'. It says 'Nothing can run until you save a new API key in Settings.', with no Yes/No and no session.

fixed.problem: L4-creds-7: After the ask card was answered, 'Waits for your answer: use your API key? The card is in the Inbox.' stayed on the session page, the Last result and the Inbox Update.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/credential-ask-words.test.ts > describe 'l4-cred-engine, run L4: a stored result's ask form after the card is answered' (both Wait and Use API key)

The session page and the Overview's Last result say 'Waits until 15:00 (your subscription's limit); then your session goes on.' After Use API key they say 'Went on with your API key.' This stays the same after a restart.

new_problems: scrubEnv in agent/sdk.ts passes the host's CLAUDE* and CCR_* variables to the Claude Code subprocess. With them, the real-SDK contract test took about 245 s, so packages/runtime/test/sdk-contract.test.ts hides /^(CCR_|CLAUDE|https?_proxy$|NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS$)/i. A daemon started from a shell that has those set would leak them to every task run.
A critic review that meets the plan share is still a budget pause (the runner's review path, around the l4-money-pause region), not the credential stop 'share' that the executor now gives a task run.
validZone still falls back to UTC for a missing zone. The callers in this area now read the person row at each use, but other users of validZone keep the fallback.
Scheduled jobs (calibration, model watch) read the person's zone at start, not at each use as the credential sentences now do.
docs:check in pnpm check diffs against origin/main, which this checkout lacks, so it prints 'nothing to check'. Run it with DOCS_CHECK_BASE=<base> in worktrees.

The bench walk used --provider bench-api (the Messages API stand-in, no real key, no money), not --provider bench. --provider bench injects a provider and bypasses the credential policy, so none of this area's paths can be walked on it. bench-live was never used.
notes_for_other_areas: failureReply(error) in packages/runtime/src/conversation/depth.ts returns {text, askAgain}: one sentence per error code, never the error's message. A chat.reply row for a failed answer is a notice and carries failed:true where Ask again helps; the conversation view's turn.failed shows Ask again, and the UI never shows Think it through under it.

chatHoldReply (session/credential-words.ts) now depends on the reason and ends 'I can still add and change tasks.' for every stop (no 'move and start'). A refused credential gets 'Save a new key in Settings' or 'Sign in again in Settings'.
StreamEvent 'error' may carry billing (CallBilling), and collectStream keeps it as ModelResponse.billing. The loop applies it with takeBilling before booking a cut-off call.
RouteContext.nowMs is required (billing router). The cloud runner passes its clock (PickRunnerBillingOptions.clock).
AskAnswerDeps.onGrant(sourceId, projectIds, {since, again}). The ask card's change_card carries applying {stopKey, at} while an apply is under way.
SdkDriverDeps.baseURL is set from config.anthropicApiBase; the default address is never sent.
compose's chatRoom can return level 'plan' (the subscription's share room) beside 'month' and 'project'.
PlanAllowanceView.changeLine, billing.waits.allowanceRaised() and limits.planAllowanceSetAt (L4-creds-1). Reported plan shares count only from the allowance's last change.
resultAfterWait (daemon/run-indicator.ts) also rewrites CE-7's ask form once its card is no longer open. Every reader of a stored result should keep going through it.
Run indicator: pendingPersonStarts includes starts by 'continuation', so nextProject names a queued continuation.

Test helpers: cred-world.ts gained setProviderScript (hold a chat or provider call on Claude Code), setKey('error') (the API's 500), the apiBase option (a config.json), and exports syntheticError, sdkThrow, REFUSED_SIGN_IN_TEXT and providerReply. testenv's Messages API stand-in has KeyAnswer {kind:'error'}.

Suggested design §3.9 States line for core-experience.md (session lead): a held chat question says 'I can still add and change tasks.' (no start promised); under a refused credential, chat's start gets the Start dialog's sentence.
